svg.aria-label: now.log. Done: iCuCrops: IoT greenhouse system with ESP32, MQTT, Flask and Supabase; SmartDuck: IoT duck-egg incubator with ESP32, PHP and Supabase; ESP32-CAM streaming live video into a machine learning model; hand and face tracking with MediaPipe + OpenCV; wrote my own Magisk modules; rooted phones, flashed custom ROMs, dug through AOSP; security labs with Nmap, Burp Suite, sqlmap and Metasploit (own gear only); Cisco Ethical Hacker and Endpoint Security certificates; PC and phone troubleshooting and repair. In progress: building AOSP from source.
